purpose: Eat Kenshi, build it better in Rust. Offer to Lo-Fi Games as the Kenshi 2 engine.
model: sourDough — fermented, not compiled. Each version is a yeast bubble.

starter.flour: Ogre3D vtable analysis + D3D11 RenderSystem reverse engineering
starter.water: Rust cdylib + DLL injection via Ogre plugin system
starter.salt: MSVC ABI compatibility (x64 vtable layout, SSO strings)

bubbles.name: First Rise
bubbles.redox: OXIDATION — DLL loads, Ogre symbols resolve, but crashes on pure virtuals
bubbles.lesson: Cannot register a base RenderSystem — Ogre calls pure virtual methods

bubbles.name: The Investigator
bubbles.redox: REDUCTION — step back, observe. Map the D3D11 vtable (64 slots)
bubbles.lesson: getName is slot 1. 16 stubs in 0x617d7fxx range. mName at offset 8 was empty.

bubbles.name: First Siege
bubbles.redox: OXIDATION — clone vtable, patch getName, register. GOT 2 RENDERERS! Then crashed.
bubbles.lesson: addRenderSystem works! But other methods hit D3D11 internal pointers. Need ALL stubs.

bubbles.name: Safe Siege
bubbles.redox: REDUCTION — stub ALL 64 slots. Only getName returns our string. Log which slots launcher calls.
bubbles.lesson: pending — will learn which methods the launcher actually invokes

bubbles.name: The Dropdown
bubbles.redox: OXIDATION — implement the specific methods the launcher needs (from v0.7.1 logs)
bubbles.lesson: pending — 'Vulkan (Reborn)' in dropdown, selectable without crash

bubbles.name: Config Dialog
bubbles.redox: OXIDATION — return valid config options (resolution, fullscreen, vsync)
bubbles.lesson: pending — user can configure Vulkan renderer settings

bubbles.name: First Render
bubbles.redox: THE BIG OXIDATION — wgpu/Vulkan actually renders a frame
bubbles.lesson: pending — Kenshi renders through our Vulkan backend

redox_principle.oxidation: ADD capability — risk of crash, but gain knowledge
redox_principle.reduction: REMOVE risk — step back, observe, stabilize
redox_principle.cycle: Each bubble: oxidize (try) → observe → reduce (stabilize) → prove → next bubble
redox_principle.sourdough: The starter culture is the Ogre ABI knowledge. Each bubble feeds the next.

chemistry.Fe_to_Pt: Iron (raw Rust code) → refined through redox → Platinum (production engine)
chemistry.yeast: Each DLL version = one yeast generation. It proves or it dies.
